title.purpose: Page and workspace titles with restrained emphasis.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact primary action for a clear next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--accent-primary); color: #fffaf7; font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font-ui); white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms var(--ease-ui), border-color 150ms var(--ease-ui), color 150ms var(--ease-ui); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral action that sits beside a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--fg-primary); font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font-ui); white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms var(--ease-ui), border-color 150ms var(--ease-ui); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action for utility or secondary navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--fg-secondary); font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font-ui); transition: background 150ms var(--ease-ui), color 150ms var(--ease-ui); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg-primary); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact content field used by the inspector.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--fg-secondary); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 33px; padding: 8px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--fg-primary); font: 400 13px/1.6 var(--font-ui); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-subtle); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A semantic rail item with a quiet active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-secondary); text-align: left; font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui); transition: background 150ms var(--ease-ui), color 150ms var(--ease-ui); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg-primary); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: var(--accent-subtle); color: var(--accent-text); font-weight: 520; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Panel Heading
components.description: A compact heading row that anchors an inspector or panel.
components.css: .ds-panel-heading { height: 41px; min-height: 41px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--fg-primary); font: 550 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui); } .ds-panel-meta { color: var(--fg-muted); font: 400 11px/1.4 var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Canvas Paper
components.description: The rendered paper surface inside the editor canvas.
components.css: .ds-canvas-paper { position: relative; display: block; min-height: 180px; padding: 16px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--fg-primary); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px #3e342210; outline: 1px solid #dedbd4; font: 400 11px/1.5 var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Inspector Empty State
components.description: A direct, calm prompt when no canvas section is selected.
components.html: A place for the details.Select a section on the canvas or in the page tree.
components.css: .ds-empty { min-height: 220px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 24px; color: var(--fg-muted); text-align: center; font: 400 12px/1.7 var(--font-ui); } .ds-empty svg { color: var(--fg-secondary); } .ds-empty strong { color: var(--fg-primary); font: 500 15px/1.4 var(--font-ui); }

narrative.overview:
Clayface is a serious design and productivity workspace for long, focused sessions. Its product chrome is warm, neutral, compact, and structured so generated websites remain the visual focus. Geist provides a neutral, high-legibility voice; borders, modest radii, and small tonal shifts make hierarchy clear without ornamental noise.

The current Operate direction documents the implemented fixture-driven shell: a stable frame, explicit editing scope, browser-local save state, and a canvas rendered from the same source used by preview. Sample content remains labeled, and generated content keeps its own palette inside the shared renderer.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral chrome with restrained clay accent #965B40.
Compact labels and controls on a 4px spacing scale.
Crisp borders and tonal layering before shadow.
48px top bar, 224px navigation, and 288px inspector on desktop.
Responsive drawer behavior, visible keyboard focus, and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome Rule
rules.body: Keep product chrome predominantly neutral; use the product accent where an action, selection, or identity needs to be found.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Use surface changes and borders before adding shadow. A shadow should explain a temporary layer or a canvas boundary.

rules.name: The Scanability Rule
rules.body: Keep product UI in the compact 11–14px range and use line-height that supports fast scanning.

dos: Do use the exact warm neutral product surfaces and shared tokens for workbench UI.
Do keep the 48px top bar, 224px navigation, and 288px inspector proportions unless a responsive rule applies.
Do use the shared renderer for editor canvas and preview.
Do provide keyboard access, named icon buttons, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do label fixture content and browser-local state clearly.
donts: Don't introduce a separate brand visual workshop or imply a visual direction beyond the current Operate workbench.
Don't use oversized UI typography, large SaaS radii, or decorative gradients in product chrome.
Don't let the clay accent dominate the editor or recolor generated site content.
Don't imply live auth, Figma connection, server generation, or Next.js export in fixture UI.
Don't make color the sole carrier of selection, status, danger, or success.
